verdict.rationale: Entrust IDV documents a versioned public REST API (v3.6) with OAuth client-credentials authentication. It covers the core flow programmatically: create an applicant, create a workflow run that returns an SDK token, and retrieve results via signed webhooks or polling. A probe confirmed a live llms.txt describing it as an API and SDK platform. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of API usage, and evidence that configuration such as accepted documents can be done via the API rather than only the Dashboard.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: create an applicant → create a workflow run (returns an SDK token) → collect captures via SDK → retrieve results via webhook or polling
